# external ID prefixes

Use the first two characters after the colon, preserving case.

|---|---|
| _e | [exact bucket](_e.md) |
| c_ | [exact bucket](c_.md) |
| dl | [exact bucket](dl.md) |
| dr | [exact bucket](dr.md) |
| gr | [exact bucket](gr.md) |
